source: Shopify Admin GraphQL API 2026-10 via the Shopify connector (read-only queries; no mutations)
scope: deliveryProfiles (all 6), each read with deliveryProfile(id): location groups (locations with includeInactive and includeLegacy), zones, countries, provinces (merchant profiles only) and method definitions with conditions and rates.
notes: Locations are reduced to name, active flags, city and country code. No street address, postal code or phone was queried.
Two locations appear in the delivery profiles: 'Homebase' (Toronto, CA; merchant location) and 'Printful' (fulfillment service location, CA, no city).
Merchant profiles price in CAD. The four Printful profiles were created by the Printful app and price in USD.
General profile 'United States' zone lists 48 contiguous states + DC (no AK, HI or territories). 'Ships Outside North America' US zone includes AK, HI, territories and armed-forces codes.
'Ships Outside North America' has a 'Rest Of the World' zone with no rates, so its products can't be shipped outside CA, US, AU and NZ.
activeMethodDefinitionsCount is as Shopify reports it; it can differ from the methods listed (e.g. General profile reports 5, 4 are listed).
Free Shipping is a 0.00 CAD rate with condition TOTAL_PRICE >= 129.00 CAD (merchant profiles, CA and US zones).
